title: Dry My Sponge!
description: Put your sponge in the crafting table to dry it.
body:
Ever find your sponges wet and find it annoying and tedious to go out and smelt all of your sponges or have to place the all in the nether?

This datapack makes it as simple as putting your sponge in the crafting table to dry it out.
